notes.title: Game Progress - Update 6
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
A big visual and UI update is coming to the demo in preparation for the Steam Fest. I've improved the general visual aspects of the game and added more quality of life from the feedback I've gotten.

Features

 New Grid VFX -> Path, Nodes, Map enhancements, Enemy spawn points and center point and more..
 A visual cue now shows all possible places for a path
 Major UI changes -> Path choice, inventory, keybinds, quickplacing, tutorial tips



Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug where tower and map enhancements would be placed incorreclty.


Next Steps
In the next demo update I will be adding enemies with various abilities to spice up your gameplay. Additionally I've gotten some ideas for a couple new towers and those will be coming too.

notes.title: Game Progress - Update 5
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
As I have been working on improving the demo for the October Steam Fest I decided to push a small update. I've gotten better at doing VFX so most projectiles and explosions should be looking better now :! I've also implemented some UI changes to address some clarity issues.

Features

 Inventory has been moved to the side.
 Road selection has been moved from its current UI, and now it sits on the center screen. It will allow you to better select the road piece you want.
 New Mortar Tower model
 Better settings for audio
 Update on most projectiles and tower shooting animations.


Bugfixes

 Fixed a bug where sometimes enemies would get re-respawned, while they are still moving on the path.


Next steps
For the October Fest I am planning to add a couple more tower choices, more enemies, more tower upgrades and tower progression. Additionally I've taken into account all the feedback I've gotten from people that have played the demo and I want to have the final UI for the fest too.

notes.title: Game Progress - Update 4
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!
It's been about a week since the Demo was released and with it I gathered valuable feedback that helped me implement the changed it needed!
As always I want to make the game as fun as possible so if you have any feedback feel free to share it with me here!

New features!

 New Tutorial Menu -> You can disable the tips from Settings and open an extra window with [H]
 Additional card choices on after each wave
 4 new upgrades
 Improved the way that tower placement is done. You no longer need to select a node to place a tower. Now you can place towers by hovering over a node. Holding shift will allow you to place multiple towers.
 Improve the way map upgrades/enhancements are placed. Removed the UI from the node menu and added them to the inventory. They are placed similarly to how the towers are placed.
 Upgrades are now draggable to the upgrade slots. You can now open and close the inventory indepedently of the upgrade slot you've chosen. Drag your upgrades to the towers :3
 You can now hide/show the card selection window to see better what path to pick.


Changelog

 Overall experience got a slight nerf per difficulty level.
 All towers have extra information to their tooltips.
 Vector Tower
FireRate 1.25 → 1.1
Range 7 → 6
Base Cost 60 → 100
Cost Increase per tower 60 → 75
 Tesla Tower
Dmg 75 → 100
Range 4 → 5
 Plasma Tower
FireRate 0.2 → 0.3
Cost 500 → 200
Cost Increase 250 → 100
 Gauss Tower
Fire Rate 4 → 3.5
Dmg per lvl 10 → 5
Cost 500 → 250
 Mortar Tower
Range 10 → 8
Cost Increase 75 → 100
 Fire Tower
Debuf duration 2 → 4
Bonus DMG to Armor 25% - 35%
 Energy Tower
Range 8 → 9
 Enemy Speed card
Speed 0.01 -> 0.05
 Enemy Stats card
Stats 0.02 -> 0.05

Bugfixes

 Fixed sound sometimes got stuck on a looping repeated
 Fixed spelling mistakes on cards
 Fixed text popping out of UI panels on some upgrades and towers
 Removed discount tile and replaced with new tile
 Fixed bug where the highscore continued counting after you've been defeated
